# Vandhara Agrotech
> Eco-friendly fermented organic liquids for sustainable soil health. FCO & NPOP certified.

## Products
- [Soil Recharge](https://vandharaagrotech.com/products/soil-recharge) — Beneficial Microbes Consortia. Reduces chemical fertilizer use by 30-40%. Dosage: 3-5 L/acre.
- [Root Guard](https://vandharaagrotech.com/products/root-guard) — Root Disease Shield. Prevents root rot (Fusarium, Rhizoctonia). Dosage: 3-5 L/acre.
- [Agni](https://vandharaagrotech.com/products/agni) — Growth Accelerator. Triggers dark green growth in 7 days. Dosage: 2-3 L/acre drip or 3ml/L foliar.
- [Vaayu](https://vandharaagrotech.com/products/vaayu) — Nature's Pest Defence. Restricts pests in 1st & 2nd stages. Dosage: 3-5 L/acre.
